lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr₆Ge₂ (reduced formula Cr₃Ge) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cr, 4 Ge) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ge centers have 9 Cr neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner/edge sharing between Cr- and Ge-centered polyhedra.
